description:
What will it take to make healthcare in the US more affordable — and where could Democrats and Republicans actually agree?

In a collaboration with News Not Noise, founder Jessica Yellin joins Vox senior correspondent Dylan Scott to discuss Democrats’ healthcare agenda following their big blue wave. They cover  the obstacles to reversing Medicaid cuts, and potential bipartisan action on prescription drug prices, Medicare payments, and surprise medical bills.

author: Vox
description:
When your aging parents can’t put down their phones, where does care end and control begin?

Subscribe to our channel! http://goo.gl/0bsAjO

In this episode, Vox reporter and producer Miles Bryan talks with internet culture reporter Jessica Lucas about the older adults who are getting hooked on AI-generated videos, and their grown children who are trying to intervene. Her reporting follows families navigating sleepless nights, health misinformation, subscription traps, and an uncomfortable reversal: the parents who may have once warned their kids about screen time as children, now need help managing their own.

They explore how grief and loneliness can draw people into endless scrolling, who profits from keeping them there, and what researchers can (and can’t) tell us about the effects on the aging brain.
